about.title: About Mandalart
about.heading: What is a Mandalart?
about.intro: A goal-setting tool created by Japanese designer Hiroaki Imaizumi, famously used by baseball player Shohei Ohtani in high school.
about.mini_note: A traditional Mandalart has 81 cells, but miniManda lets you start light with 9.
about.step1: Write the goal you want to achieve in the center
about.step2: Write the key elements in the 8 surrounding cells
about.step3: Write specific actions for each element
about.step4: Track your progress and reach your goal
